title: Renewals Coordinator
description:
Workable covers the full hiring-to-employment lifecycle in one platform. A mature applicant tracking system, with access to 200+ job boards and 400M+ candidate profiles, sits alongside employee management, onboarding, time tracking, and performance tools. In 2026, Workable launched the first end-to-end AI recruiting agent: it sources, screens, and qualifies candidates autonomously. Over 6,000 companies in 100+ countries use Workable. 35,000+ companies have hired through it, making 2.1 million hires and counting.

About the team

Renewals is where Workable's revenue gets protected. The team works directly with customers everywhere we operate, helping them get more value out of the data Workable gives them about their people and their hiring, and making sure that value shows up in the numbers when it's time to renew.

About the role

As a Renewals Coordinator, you'll own the renewal cycle for a defined book of business, following the playbook and pricing guidance the team has already built. You'll run most renewals independently, and loop in a senior teammate the moment a negotiation gets complicated or a contract needs a structure outside the norm. This is a high-volume, global book, and data and dashboards will tell you where to focus — but you'll also build the judgment to know when the standard motion is enough and when an account needs more attention.

It's a great stepping stone for someone who wants to learn how we work at Workable, understand our customers, and build real commercial depth, one account at a time. The experience will help you develop a strong foundation for future opportunities across our go-to-market (GTM) teams.

What you'll do

• Own the end-to-end renewal cycle for your book of business: keep every quote-to-close step accurate and on schedule, and stay on top of a high volume of accounts so nothing falls through the cracks

• Read account data through Salesforce, dashboards, and health scores to catch renewal risk early, decide where your attention is best spent, and keep an accurate forecast

• Handle renewal negotiations using approved pricing and packaging guidance, and lean on the team's playbook and senior teammates when a deal turns complex

• Get in front of key stakeholders before the renewal is due, to learn their budget cycle and anything that could hold the deal up

• Walk customers through pricing and packaging options, using templates and guidance the team has built

• Make the case for Workable's value clearly, in writing and in conversation

• Feed what you learn back into the team's playbooks: email cadences, segmentation, whatever makes the next renewal easier

This is a great fit if you want to start your commercial career somewhere that will teach you the fundamentals of account management and renewals, with a clear playbook and real ownership from day one.

Requirements

• 0–2 years of experience in a customer-facing, sales, or account management role — you're early in your career and eager to build real commercial skills

• Strong personal organization: you can run many things in parallel and keep track of every one of them

• Comfortable picking up new tools — Salesforce, spreadsheets, dashboards — to read customer data and prioritize your work

• An interest in pricing, negotiation, and how a subscription business actually works

• A genuine sense of ownership: you notice when something needs attention before someone has to tell you

• Clear, concise writing, especially over email

• A collaborative streak, and comfort adjusting to shifting priorities in a fast-moving environment

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to communicate clearly and professionally with customers in English.

• Eligible to work in Greece

• Direct experience with subscription renewals or retention work, such as managing renewal cycles, handling churn-risk accounts, or negotiating pricing and packaging at renewal, is a plus.

Benefits

Our employees enjoy benefits that make them more productive and contribute directly to the development of their professional skills. We want to be able to attract the best of the best and make sure they keep getting better. On top of an exciting, vibrant, and intellectually challenging workplace, we offer:

• 💼 Compensation: Annual salary of 20,000-25,000 EUR

• 📋 Comprehensive Coverage: Private Health Insurance, and Medical Plan to keep you and your loved ones secure.

• 💰 Financial Wellness: Performance Bonuses to invest in your future.

• 📱 Stay Connected: Cell phone reimbursement for seamless communication.

• 🛠️ Work in Style: Apple gear provided to set you up for success.

Workable is most decidedly an equal opportunity employer. We want applicants of diverse backgrounds and hire without regard to race, color, gender, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Workable makes software to help companies find and hire great people. We get recruiting and its role in building healthy workplaces — which is why we’re proud more than 20,000 teams around the world use Workable to do exactly that.

And while we take recruiting seriously, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. At Workable, you’ll find smart people who have fun, learn and innovate, and help others do the same. We brainstorm, we laugh, and, occasionally, we party (there’s a lot to celebrate), but we also appreciate people’s need for quiet time and focused work. We respect everyone, we hire the best, and make sure every experience is special.

We’re growing fast, in both headcount and revenue, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to design, build and roll-out products that deliver Workable's vision and strategy.

As a Senior Product Manager you will:

• Understand user needs and gather feature requests to incorporate them into product roadmap

• Describe the user experience and product features

• Collect and analyse data to validate goal

• Collaborate with the development team

• Track the project progress

• Test and accept delivered product features according to user stories

• Coordinate the product release launch

• Translate user feedback and research results into recommendations to executive management

• Work with key external partnerships to augment the value of the product

Requirements

• What you’ll bring

• 5+ years of experience in technical product management.

• A track record of managing products through the full lifecycle.

• A solid technical foundation, with an understanding of software development and web technologies, and the ability to work effectively with software development teams.

• Experience working in Agile product development environments and managing product integrations.

• Experience using AI tools.

• Strong presentation skills, including experience sharing recommendations with executive leadership.

• A BSc degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Nice to have

• An MSc degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience in HR tech.

• Experience conducting direct customer discovery.

• Experience managing external partners.

Benefits

Our employees enjoy benefits that make them more productive and contribute directly to the development of their professional skills. We want to be able to attract the best of the best and make sure they keep getting better. On top of an exciting, vibrant, and intellectually challenging workplace, we offer:

• Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents.

• Competitive compensation and a performance-based bonus.

• A hybrid working model, with two days working from home and three days in the office.

• Apple equipment and the tools you need to do your best work.

• A mobile data plan to help you stay connected.

• Fresh food at the office.

• A relocation bonus to support your move to Athens, if applicable.

Workable is most decidedly an equal opportunity employer. We want applicants of diverse backgrounds and hire without regard to race, color, gender, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Regional Marketing Manager, Northern Europe
description:
Workable is a software company building an all-in-one recruiting and HR platform that helps businesses hire, manage, and grow their teams. As part of the computer software space, we work at the intersection of technology, hiring, and people operations, supporting organizations as they build stronger teams and scale with confidence.

Workable's global marketing team runs strategy, content, paid media and product marketing centrally. The Regional Marketers carry the local mandate: they make Workable visible, credible and present in their market. As North Europe’s Regional Marketing Manager, you'll be the owner of that mandate and strategy for the region, running your own budget, calendar and relationships, while working closely with the central teams who will look to you for regional insight and execution support. This is a critical GTM role reporting to the UK Country Manager: requiring hands-on delivery alongside strategic input into how global campaigns and programmes land and deliver across the market.

What you'll own end-to-end

• Regional Pipeline - Own the regional qualified pipeline target, managing execution across all campaigns and levers to deliver monthly and quarterly pipeline goals.

• Regional GTM Marketing: Translate regional GTM goals and priorities into local events and take ownership of regional campaigns and as a result attract customers and achieve revenue goals.

• Field & Events: Own the UK events strategy across Workable owned (user groups, roundtables, webinars) and third party events, including the negotiation of sponsorship packages with suppliers, organising each aspect of the delivery, representing Workable as a spokesperson and working closely with the Global SDR Director on post-event follow-up campaigns and reporting.

• Sales Partnership: Create and localise messaging and customer-facing content for Workable’s ICPs, partner with regional sales teams on targeted events and regional campaigns to build a robust pipeline of new logo and expansion opportunities.

• Customer Advocacy Programs: Establish annual content calendar, source and secure customer participation in written and video testimonials. Also own review platform initiatives, such as TrustPilot.

• Building a Community: Identify, build and help to activate the right partnerships with associations/communities and technology partners and initiate opportunities to run co-events, and create demand using digital and in-person channels.

• Media & PR relations: Identify and pursue local media/PR opportunities across Northern Europe, particularly in the UK

• Localisation of website and content: Own opportunities to localise content available on Workable’s website for Northern European markets

Requirements

• 4–7 years in B2B marketing, with real ownership of a regional or field marketing remit: agency, in-house or a mix

• Strong, hands-on events and trade show experience: sourcing venues, presenting, managing budgets, running a stand or roundtable series yourself

• Comfortable holding a budget and being accountable for how it's spent and what it returns and being able to report on this to leadership

• Confident working with a sales organisation: Account Management and New Business teams will look to you to support pipeline and expansion

• Strong written and verbal communicator and presenter who can represent a global brand consistently across multiple local markets, including at events with press and media contacts

• Organised self-starter: this role runs its own calendar with limited day-to-day oversight and will require operating with attention to detail at all times

Nice to have

• Experience in HR tech, recruiting, or another B2B SaaS category

• Existing relationships with N. Europe HR/recruiting analysts, associations, journalists or media outlets

• Familiarity with G2/Capterra/TrustPilot review programmes

• Video production or customer testimonial sourcing experience

• Experience covering more than one country/market from a single regional seat

What success looks like in year one

• Pipeline and revenue targets are met, with pipeline creation improving quarter over quarter across new logo and expansion opportunities and net-retention of the existing customer base

• Regional field & events and campaigns, both direct and in partnership with community associations and technology partners consistently deliver pipeline influence, and insights from the region systematically inform global messaging and content

• Relevant customer case studies captured, available and promoted via Workable channels

• Sales partnership is strong and visible: shared plans, clear cadences, aligned reporting, and measurable acceleration on top accounts and opportunities

• The budget is proactively managed with a clear ROI narrative and a test-and-learn roadmap tied to pipeline impact

Benefits

Benefits

Our employees enjoy benefits that support their productivity and professional development. Alongside an exciting, vibrant and intellectually challenging workplace, we offer:

• 💰 Competitive Pay: A salary of £65,000–£85,000

• 🛡️ Comprehensive Coverage: Private health insurance and a pension plan.

• 📱 Stay Connected: Cell phone reimbursement for seamless communication.

• 🛠️ Work in Style: Apple equipment to set you up for success.

• 🍴 Daily Fuel: A daily lunch allowance to keep you energized and productive.

• 🏡 Hybrid Working: One day per week working from home.

Workable is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and hire without regard to race, color, gender, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, age, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by law.
